title_html: Can You Sell Digital Products on TikTok Shop? The Real Rules, Not the Workaround
description: Yes, but only through TikTok Shop's invite-only Virtual Goods category. Here's exactly what's allowed, what's still prohibited, and what to try instead.
dek: TikTok Shop's Prohibited Products Policy blocks digital and virtual items by default. Here's what the invite-only Virtual Goods category actually allows, straight from TikTok's own Seller Center documentation, and what to build instead if you don't have an invite.
author: Jackie He
keywords: can you sell digital products on tiktok shop
cta_pre: Build the GMV lever that doesn't need an invitation.
llms_summary: TikTok Shop prohibits digital and virtual products by default; they're only sellable through an invite-only Virtual Goods category covering software licenses, digital games, in-game content, prepaid subscriptions, online courses, virtual gift cards and event tickets, each capped at $500 per listing with a $10,000/24-hour transaction limit, 2-business-day electronic delivery, and no auto-renewal or refunds - verified against TikTok's own Seller Center Virtual Goods Requirements and Prohibited Products Policy pages. For brands without an invite, the faster real lever is testing a new physical SKU or bundle and building creator distribution, not chasing the locked digital-goods category.
